notes: Southern Tidings news (union magazine) was used to confirm and explain calendar items. Best-documented calendar in the Southern Union: a printed 2026 SAC Event Calendar (7 pages, every month) plus a public iCal feed of website events. Where the PDF and the event page disagree the event page date is used and the difference noted. Office closures, school start/resume dates and merchandise sales were left out. Recurring monthly items (PARL Advisory, MOMCo Moms Meet Up, LifeSpace Marketplace open days, committees) are listed once with a count. Several Hispanic and Franco-Haitian tracks (church officer training, couples, women, men, children, camp meetings, pastors' reunion) show a strong multilingual layer. Be Ready Summit (on the PDF for 30 Sep-4 Oct 2026) appears in the event feed as 'Be Ready Summit New Date' 15-18 Apr 2027, i.e. moved outside the window. Category is assigned from the event title (descriptions are mostly empty); where the title does not say what the event is, category 'other' is used.
